mchod do 'bul lo/'od dpag med/'jig rten dbang phyugapadma 'byung gnas/ye shes mtsho rgyal/rol pa'i rdo rje/drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du

tei:div.tei:p: mchod do 'bul lo/ 'od dpag med/ 'jig rten dbang phyug padma 'byung gnas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma rgyal ba kun 'dus/ rdo rje 'chang yab yum/ kun tu bzang po yab yum/ tshe dpag med/ spyan ras gzigs/ thod phreng rtsal bzhi/ rdo rje rigs bzhi/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi/ sgo ba bzhi/ lha dang rig 'dzin/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro /dam can srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ che mchog drag byed phur bu/ padma he ru ka yab yum/ bya khyung rgyal po/ 'jam dpal yab yum/ rta mgrin yab yum/ gsang bdag yab yum/ phag mo sde lnga/ me dbal yab yum/ rmongs byed mched gsum/ lcags sdig nag po/ drag po rtsal bzhi/ phur pa rigs bzhi/ khro mo bzhi/ khro rgyal bcu/ khra thabs nyi shu/ sgo ma bzhi/ dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam gu ru drag khros/ phyag rdor/ 'jam dpal/ rta mgrin/ sku gsum sprul pa'i khyung chen/ drag mo gdong can mched bzhi/ khyung chen rigs bzhi/ rang rang gi sprul pa dpag tu med pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos skyong lha chen ma hā ka la/ las mgon srog bdud nag po/ nyi zla thod phreng ma/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mgon po sde lnga/ dregs pa sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ ma mo/ bdud mo/ sha za/ zhing skyong bye ba 'bum dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rā hu la yab yum/ sring mo bzhi/ gza' brgyad/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ gza'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skyes bu btsan rgod 'bar ba/ gnam lha/ the'u rang*/ mon pa/ jag pa/ mched 'khor/ brtan ma/ shan pa/ btsan rgod/ dge bsnyen 'khor bcas kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnod sbyin rgyal po rnam mang thos sras/

sprul pa'i rta bdag brgyad/ 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'khor bcas kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong chen po yab yum sha za bye ba 'bum dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gter srung rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ nor bu 'od ldan/ gdol pa lag ring*/ so so'i 'khor tshogs bsam las 'das pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas gang bcol gyi las zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzad du gsol/
karma rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtshos so//
